subject: Reconvene: short follow-up requested after additional gatekeepers added
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Heads-up: Acme added procurement + security — need to reblock

Hi team,

Quick update from my call with Alice at Acme: they just pulled in their procurement lead and a couple of security engineers to the demo track. Procurement wants contract and data residency Qs covered; security wants a short deep-dive on our private deployment and audit logging.

Our current 60-minute slot (June 18) will be tight if we include both sets of stakeholders. I propose two options:

- Option A (preferred): Keep the product walkthrough to a focused 30-min session for the core product audience, then schedule a separate 45-min technical/compliance session (security + procurement) the following week.
- Option B: Expand the June 18 slot to 90 minutes and push a few product topics to a follow-up doc — risk here is stakeholder fatigue and calendar conflicts.

Attached a trimmed agenda and the Acme security questionnaire they sent over. Can Marissa and Vivek weigh in on which approach preserves momentum? If A, Marissa can you send a short pre-read to security so they come with specific asks.

Thanks — Lukas

--
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0125
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Heads-up: Acme added procurement + security — need to reblock

On Mon, Jun 4, 2028 at 10:12 AM Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick update from my call with Alice at Acme: they just pulled in their procurement lead and a couple of security engineers to the demo track.

Agree with Option A. Short product run keeps decision-makers engaged; separate compliance session makes it easier for our infra/security SMEs to prepare. I can draft a 2-page pre-read for SecurityOps with the specific areas they flagged (audit logs, network isolation, KMS, data deletion SLA).

Suggested plan:
- June 18, 09:00–09:30 PT: Product highlights + business fit (Lukas + Marissa)
- June 25, 10:00–10:45 PT: Security & Procurement deep-dive (Vivek + Kimberly lead)

Vivek — can you confirm availability for the 25th? Kimberly, we may need you for the KMS/keys portion.

I'll attach the pre-read to the invite once confirmed.

— Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Heads-up: Acme added procurement + security — need to reblock

Thanks — Option A works for me. I should be available June 25 at 10:00 PT; I'll block time and loop in platform infra docs. One ask: can we get the security team’s top 3 priorities ahead of time so we can tailor the deep-dive? If Procurement has specific contract terms they want discussed (retention, SLAs), send those too and Kimberly can prepare the KMS/tenant isolation slides.

Kimberly — ping me if you need any infra artifacts from our side; I can surface traces and example audit entries from a sandbox.

-Vivek

Hi Marissa / Lukas,

Thanks — that split sounds good and should keep things efficient for our group. Confirming:

- June 18, 09:00–09:30 PT: Product walkthrough (we'll have the head of product + a PM)
- June 25, 10:00–10:45 PT: Security + Procurement (we will have 2 security engineers and our procurement manager)

I've attached an initial list of procurement terms and the top security questions (rows called "priority") in the spreadsheet — hope that helps. If you can share the 2-page pre-read by end of week, our security team will triage and put together any follow-ups.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Regards,

alice.wu@acmehealth.com
